name: Khârn the Betrayer — an opponent of your choice gains control of it
notes: Sweep group 6 (2026-10-07). "If damage would be dealt to this card, prevent that damage and an opponent of your choice gains control of it." is a replacement effect on a static line, so nothing could fire it. It is now offered like a trigger (extractTriggeredAbilities) and "an opponent of your choice" is a player picked from the dropdown; the control is pinned to Khârn. Also: "When you lose control of this card, draw two cards." behind its ability word used to parse as a static "loses Control of this card, Draw two cards" effect; a player losing control of something is no longer read as losing abilities (same for Seraph, Coffin Queen, Krovikan Vampire and four more).

$includes: Sigil of Corruption — When you lose control of this card, draw two cards.
